about: The JRuby lesson's bonus: JRuby 9.4 (Ruby 3.1) on CheerpJ 4.3, a JVM in WebAssembly, with Glimmer DSL for Swing, JFreeChart and FlatLaf (html/jruby_swing.html). The CheerpJ runtime itself comes from Leaning Technologies' CDN (cjrtnc.leaningtech.com/4.3/loader.js) and is not vendored.

built.build: ./run.sh prepare (needs a JDK and network: patch/build.sh, patch/glimmer/build.sh)

cheerpj-patch.jar.about: JRuby's ConstantField, patched so Java's static final char/short/float constants work under CheerpJ (patch/src)

glimmer-swing-gems.jar.about: glimmer-dsl-swing 0.0.5 and its pure-Ruby gems, packed as a jar (require 'glimmer-cheerpj')
